(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit and triggering an event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit, wherein said triggering an event comprises either waveform digitization or waveform synthesis.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises either waveform digitization or waveform synthesis.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises either waveform digitization or waveform synthesis.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform digitization and further comprises waveform synthesis, said waveform synthesis being performed on a shared channel of said module.
